name: vscode-pr-cascade
description: Stacked pull requests in VS Code — see the stack, click a layer for its diff, create and restack PRs on GitHub and GitLab

prCascade.trunk.markdownDescription: The ref the stack is measured against, e.g. `main` or `origin/main`. Leave empty to auto-detect: the remote's default branch (`origin/HEAD`), then `origin/main`, `origin/master`, `main`, `master`. A value that does not exist in the repository shows "No trunk found" rather than falling back.

prCascade.gitPath.markdownDescription: The git executable to run. `git` means whatever is first on PATH; set a full path when git lives somewhere unusual.

prCascade.remote.markdownDescription: The remote whose default branch is consulted first when auto-detecting the trunk. Change it if you work on a fork and keep the original repository as `upstream`.

prCascade.repositoryScanMaxDepth.markdownDescription: How many levels below each workspace folder to look for repositories. `0` looks only at the folders themselves; `1` (the default) also looks in their immediate subfolders — the layout where a parent folder is open and the repositories live under it; `-1` sets no limit, which on a large folder starts one git process per directory, all at once. Same meaning as `git.repositoryScanMaxDepth`. Anything but a whole number of -1 or more is treated as the default.

prCascade.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders.markdownDescription: Folder names skipped while looking for repositories below a workspace folder, at any level. Same meaning as `git.repositoryScanIgnoredFolders`. A value that is not a list is treated as the default; an entry in the list that is not a name is dropped.

scripts.test:ext: npm run build && rm -rf out && tsc -p tsconfig.ext.json && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:git
